Références

Richards, B. A. & al. (2009). « Patterns of cortical thinning
in Alzheimer’s disease and frontotemporal dementia »,
Neurobiology of Aging, 30(10), p. 1626-1636.

Robillard, A. (2007). «Clinical diagnosis of dementia »,
Alzheimer’s & Dementia, 3(4), p. 292-298.

Siddiqi, N. & al. (2007). « Interventions for preventing deli-
rium in hospitalised patients », Cochrane Database System
Review, 18(2), p. 1-3.

Sperling, R. A. & al. (2011). « Toward dening the preclinical
stages of Alzheimer’s disease : Recommen dations from the
National Institute on Aging-Alzheimer’s Association work-
groups on diagnostic guidelines for Alzheimer’s disease »,
Alzheimer’s & Dementia, 7, p. 280-292.

Sunderland, T. & al. (1989). « Clock drawing in Alzheimer’s
disease : A novel measure of dementia severity », Journal
of the American Geriatrics Society, 37(8), p. 725-729.

Thomas, A. J. & O’Brien, J. T. (2008). « Depression and
cognition in older adults », Current Opinions in Psychiatry,
21(8), p. 8-13.

Thorpe, L. (2009). « Dépression ou démence ? Comment
aborder l’évaluation du patient », Revue canadienne de la
maladie d’Alzheimer et autres démences, (9), p. 17-21.

Troisième conférence canadienne de consensus sur le diagnostic
et le traitement de la démence. (2007). 146 recommandations
approuvées, verson nale, [en ligne], www.cccdtd.ca/pdfs/
Recommandations_approuvees_CCCDTD_2007.pdf.

Trzepacz, P. T. & al. (2005). « Delirium », dans Levenson, J.
L. (dir.), The American Psychiatric Publishing Textbook of
Psychosomatic Medicine, 2e éd., Arlington, VA, American
Psychiatric Publishing, p. 71-114.

Van Eijk, M. M. & Roes, K. C. (2010). « Effect of rivastigmine
as an adjunct to usual care with haloperidol on duration
of delirium and mortality in critically ill patients : A multi-
centre, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomised trial »,

Villeneuve, S. & Belleville, S. (2010). « Réserve cognitive et
changements associés au vieillissement », Psychologie et
neuropsychiatrie du vieillissement, 8(2), p. 133-140.

Psychiatric Publishing Textbook of Alzheimer disease and
other dementias, Washington, DC, American Psychiatric
Publishing.

Weintraub, D. & Hurtig, H. I. (2007). « Presentation and
management of psychosis in Parkinson’s disease and
dementia with Lewy bodies », American Journal of Psychia-
try, 164(10), p. 1491-1498.

Wheaton, P.& al. (2011). « Impact of pharmacological treat-
ments on cognitive and behavioural outcome in the postacute
stages of adult traumatic brain injury : A meta-analysis »,
Journal of Clinical Psy chopharmacology, 31(6), p. 745-757.

Wiederkehr, S. & al. (2008). « Comparability of the clinical
diagnostic criteria for vascular dementia : A critical review »,
Journal of Neuropsychiatry and Clinical Neurosciences,
20(2), p. 150-161.

Yudofsky, S. C. & Hales, R. E. (2008). The American Psychia-
tric Publishing Textbook of neuropsychiatry and behavioral
neurosciences, 5e éd., Washington, DC, American Psychia-
tric Publishing.

dies du cœur et des accidents vasculaires cérébraux au
Canada, [en ligne], www.phac-aspc.gc.ca/publicat/2009/
cvd-avc/index-fra.php.

publication/survreport/estimat2011-fra.php.

Disease and Other Dementias, Arlington, VA, American

logical approaches to the management of neuropsychiatric

Mackenzie, I. & al. (2010). « Nomenclature and nosology for
neuropathologic subtypes of frontotemporal lobar degene-
ration : an update », Acta Neuropathologica, 119(1), p. 1-4.

Massoud, F. (2009). «La maladie d’Alzheimer, mise à jour
en 2009 », Le Médecin du Québec, 44(4), p. 83-88.

Massoud, F. & Léger, G. C. (2011). « Pharmacological
treatment of Alzheimer disease », Canadian Journal of
Psychiatry, 56(10), p. 579-588.

McKeith, I. G. & al. (2005). « Diagnosis and management
of dementia with Lewy bodies : Third report of the DLB

Mendez, M. & al. (2007). « Preliminary Findings : Behavioral

Dementia », American Journal of Geriatric Psychiatry, 15(1),

gnosis », dans Miller, B. L. & Boeve, B. F., The Behavioural

Press, p. 1-6.

Morris, J. C. (1993). « The Clinical Dementia Rating Scale
(CDR) : Current version and scoring rules », Neurology,
43(11), p. 2412-2414.

Nasreddine, Z. S. & al. (2005). « The Montreal Cognitive
Assessment (MoCA) : A brief screening tool For Mild Cogni-
tive Impairment », Journal of American Geriatrics Society,
53(4), p. 695-699.

Olin, J. T. & al. (2001). « A pilot randomized trial of carba-
mazepine for behavioral symptoms in treatment-resistant
outpatients with Alzheimer disease », American Journal of
Geriatric Psychiatry, 9(4), p. 400-405.

Ozkan, B. & al. (2008). « Pharmacotherapy for inappropriate
sexual behaviors in dementia : A systematic review of
literature », American Journal of Alzheimer’s disease and
Other Dementias, 23(4), p. 344-354.

Pelland, C. & Trudel, J. F. (2009). «Atypical antipsychotic
efcacy and safety in managing delirium : A systematic
review and critical analysis », Psychol Neuropsychiatr Vieil,
7(2), p. 109-119.

Petersen, R. C. & al. (2001). « Practice parameter : Early
detection of dementia : Mild cognitive impairment (an
evidence-based review). Report of the Quality Standards

Neurology, 56(9), p. 1133-1142.

Raina, P. & al. (2008). « Effectiveness of cholinesterase
inhibitors and memantine for treating dementia : Evidence

Medicine, 148(5), p. 379-397.

Rayner, S. G. & al. (2012). « Dexmedetomidine as adjunct
treatment for severe alcohol withdrawal in the ICU »,
Annals of Intensive Care, 2(1), p. 1-6.

Rewilak, D. (2007). « Behavior management strategies »,
dans Conn, D. K., & al. (dir.), Practical Psychiatry in the

bridge, Royaume-Uni, Hogrefe Publishing, p. 217-237.

Goldmann, G. R. & al. (2008). « Cognitive impairment in
Parkinson’s disease and dementia with Lewy bodies : a
spectrum of disease », Neurosignals, 16(1), p. 24-34.

Gorno-Tempini, M. L. & al. (2011). « Classication of primary
progressive aphasia and its variants », Neurology, 76(11),
p. 1006-1014.

Hachinski, V. C. & al. (1975). « Cerebral blood ow in demen-
tia », Archives of Neurology, 32(9), p. 632-637.

Haw, C. & al. (2009). « Dementia and suicidal behaviour :
A review of the literature », International Psychogeriatric,
21(3), p. 440-453.

Herrmann, N. & Gauthier, S. (2008). « Diagnosis and
treatment of dementia : 6. Management of severe Alzheimer
disease », Canadian Medical Association Journal, 179(12),
p. 1279-1287.

Herrmann, N. & Lanctôt, K. L. (2007). « Pharmacologic
management of neuropsychiatric symptoms of Alzhei-
mer disease », Canadian Journal of Psychiatry, 52(10),
p. 630-646.

Herrmann, N. & al. (2013). « Pharmacological recommen-
dations for the symptomatic treatment of dementia : The
Canadian Consensus Conference on the Diagnosis and
Treatment of Dementia 2012 », Alzheimer’s Research &
Therapy, 5(suppl. 1), p. 5-19.

Hoy, S. M. & Keating, G. M. (2011). « Dexmedetomidine :
A review of its use for sedation in mechanically ventilated
patients in an intensive care setting and for procedural
sedation », Drugs, 71(11), p. 1481-1501.

Inouye, S. K. & al. (1990). « Clarifying confusion : The
confusion assessment method. A new method for detection
of delirium », Annals of Internal Medicine, 113(12),
p. 941-948.

Jellinger, K. A. (2006). « A view of early diagnosis of demen-
tias from neuropathology », dans Herholz, K. & al. (dir.), The
Dementias, Early Diagnosis and Evaluation, New York, NY,
Taylor & Francis Group, p. 311-428.

Kales, H. C. & al. (2007). « Mortality risk in patients with
dementia treated with antipsychotics versus other psychia-
tric medications », American Journal of Psychiatry, 164(10),
p. 1568-1576.

Kaul, M. (2009). «HIV-1 associated dementia : Update on
pathological mechanisms and therapeutic approaches »,
Current Opinions in Neurology, 22(3), p. 315-320.

Kivipelto, M. & al. (2006). « Risk score for the prediction of
dementia risk in 20 years among middle aged people : A
longitudinal, population-based study »,Lancet Neurology,
5(9), p. 735-741.

Knopman, D. (2011). « Alzheimer’s disease », dans Agronin,
M. E. & Maletta, G. J. (dir.), Principles and Practice of Geria-
tric Psychiatry, 2e éd., Philadelphie, PA, Lippincott Williams
& Wilkins, p. 301-315.

Kouri, R. P. & Philips-Nootens, S. (2003). « Le majeur inapte
et le refus catégorique de soins de santé : un concept pour
le moins ambigu », Revue du Barreau, 63, p. 1-28.

Laforce, R. Jr. & Rabinovici, G. D. (2011). « Amyloid imaging in
the differential diagnosis of dementia : Review and potential
clinical applications », Alzheimer’s Research & Therapy, 10(3),
p. 31-41.

Lane, R. & al. (2008). « Synergistic effect of apolipoprotein E
epsilon4 and butyrylcholinesterase K-variant on progression
from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer’s disease »,
Pharmacogenetics and Genomics, 18(4), p. 289-298.

Levenson, J. L. (2011). The American Psychiatric Publishing
Textbook of Psychosomatic Medicine, Arlington, VA, Ameri-
can Psychiatric Publishing.

Lipton, A. M. & Rubin, C. D. (2009). « Medical evaluation
and diagnosis », dans Weiner, M. F. & Lipton, A. M. (dir.),
The American Psychiatric Publishing Textbook of Alzheimer
